note: Walnut River area of El Dorado State Park (KDWP), in shaded woods below the dam beside the Walnut River: water/electric Big Oak, and full-hookup Frontier Refinery and Eagle Pass around a swim pond with a beach, plus three cabins. Bluestem Point and Boulder Bluff are their own entries. --Claude
